value.body: A mechanical design engineer creates 3D models and 2D drawings of parts and assemblies so they can be made in a factory. Automotive suppliers, machinery makers, engineering-services firms and product companies hire them. A day involves CAD modelling, checking tolerances, revising drawings and working with manufacturing and quality teams.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical or Production

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually enter as trainee or junior design engineers at engineering-services firms or manufacturers. Certification and hands-on practice in one CAD tool, plus a design project, help in interviews.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: 3D modelling and 2D drafting in a CAD tool
Preparing bills of materials and drawing revisions

value.title: At a glance
items: Much entry-level work is drafting and drawing updates before full design ownership.
Common next roles: senior design engineer, CAE/FEA analyst, product design lead.
Domain knowledge (automotive, aerospace, industrial machinery) shapes long-term options.
